note: Vendor-neutral registry of PUBLIC iperf3 endpoints, published so other users have known-good external test destinations rather than having to rediscover them. Every entry records what was ACTUALLY verified, including the ports that failed admission -- GAP-045's whole point is that a port-open check is not admission validation, and recording only the working ports would hide that. These are public services documented by their operators; no site-specific or client-side detail is retained here.

providers.authorization: public service documented by the operator; no private agreement. Treat every result as a public-endpoint measurement subject to GAP-040's loss-floor and capacity qualification.

listeners.observed: iperf3 3.16 client, Ubuntu 24.04, Ethernet MTU 1500, explicit source and interface binding. A separate 2026-08-03 run measured 55 Mbps forward and 9.4 Mbps reverse from a macOS 3.21 client.
used as the download half of an independently rate-controlled matrix, because the Salt Lake host's additional ports would not admit a second concurrent session.

known_bad_ports.outcome: failed admission or stayed at zero intervals until the safety timeout
known_bad_ports.why_it_matters: This is the exact GAP-045 shape. In an earlier fanout a substantial minority of probes never established a test connection even though their port-open checks passed; scoring those as 0 Mbps would have implicated healthy clients as failing.

caveats: The upload and download halves use DIFFERENT public paths, so a simultaneous result mixes two provider routes. Each directional control must bracket its own simultaneous result; GAP-017's endpoint-mismatch warning applies.
Each listener accepts one test at a time. Concurrency requires distinct listeners, which is why GAP-040 leases one per active session.
Old-client reverse UDP showed a 0.6-1.0% loss floor that belongs to the endpoint, not the network. GAP-040 declares that floor alongside any loss figure.

An XMission Colorado endpoint produced a duration-inconsistent 44.6 Mbps receiver summary and a 61.2 Mbps reverse ceiling on a known-healthy client. Duration validity must be checked per transport, not just reachability.
Baseline drift between opening and closing controls was severe enough that tuner profiles derived from these endpoints are provisional.

client_source_ports.what_they_are: Fixed CLIENT source ports used to hold a 5-tuple stable across ECMP/LAG hash buckets (GAP-028). They are not server listeners and must never be probed as such.
client_source_ports.finding: All ten buckets failed the same way at 350 Mbps bidirectional, forming no healthy/bad split. That argued against a single bad hash member and toward shared queue or WLAN behavior.
